headline: Become any creature you catch in Aniimo
title: Aniimo Twining Explained | Become Your Creature | Aniimo Guide
video_script: In Aniimo you don't just catch creatures, you become them. It's called Twining. Twine with any Aniimo you've collected and you take direct control of its body and skills. Glide through the sky, dive underwater or burrow underground, and use each Aniimo's abilities to solve puzzles and win real time battles. Combat is action based, so you dodge and chain attacks yourself. Which Aniimo would you Twine with first? Comment below!

scenes.sub: Twine with any creature you catch

description: Twining is Aniimo's signature mechanic: merge with any Aniimo you've caught, take control of its movement and skills, and use them to explore Idyll, solve puzzles and fight real-time battles.
